### Front line

Open-source mapping sources reported shifting territorial control, though their figures diverged. The Ukrainian mapping group DeepStateMap reported that Russian forces occupied 4.4 km² of previously contested territory and placed 22.2 km² under contestation, with 0 km² reclaimed by Ukraine. In contrast, UkrDailyUpdate reported 4.6 km² newly occupied, 21.7 km² newly contested, 6.0 km² returning to Ukrainian control (including 4% of Lyman), and 20.0 km² shifting from Russian-occupied to contested. Both sources agreed that sections of Chernihivka, Krasnopodillia, Vodianske, and Svitle in Donetsk Oblast became contested. Meanwhile, the Russian Ministry of Defence claimed that its "Vostok" grouping captured the settlement of Obshcheye in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, a claim that remains unverified. 

### Strikes and losses

The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed overnight drone strikes struck a drone storage warehouse in Olshany (Kharkiv Oblast), electrical substations in Kharkiv and Kamianets-Podilskyi, port infrastructure and warehouses in Chornomorsk, and a cargo vessel delivering military supplies to Odesa. The Russian Ministry of Defence also claimed its air defenses intercepted 290 Ukrainian drones overnight and 37 during the day over multiple Russian regions and the Black Sea.

According to geolocated footage compiled by GeoConfirmed:
- Russian strikes caused damage to the Hotel Venecia in Zaporizhzhia, an Auchan building, a dental clinic, and an out-of-service shopping mall. Russian attacks reportedly killed a civilian man in one incident, and an airstrike reportedly killed one person and wounded 10 others. Russian FPV and loitering munitions struck multiple vehicles in Slovyansk and a presumed drone position in Fedorovka.
- Ukrainian strikes included a reported HIMARS strike on a Russian tank regiment headquarters, airstrikes on a reported Russian communications hub and a restaurant in Melitopol, and drone strikes in Voronezh that damaged the "Uritsky" residential building. 

The open-source channel *lost_warinua* reported a damaged Russian Tigr-M armored vehicle in Shyroke, Zaporizhzhia Oblast. The *Economist* war-fire model detected an estimated 82 war-related fires, heavily concentrated in Luhansk Oblast (63).

### Official statements

The Ukrainian Ministry of Defence announced restrictions on planning new humanitarian demining within 20–50 km of the front line and border across six oblasts due to security risks. Ukrainian officials met with European Union representatives regarding nearly €60 billion allocated from the Ukraine Support Loan for 2026–2027 defense needs, focusing on FPV drones and strike capabilities. Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara signed a military-technical cooperation agreement with Moldova and appealed to the "E5" European defense ministries to transfer 10% of their existing air-defense interceptor stockpiles (Patriot and IRIS-T) to Ukraine under an exchange scheme for future deliveries, as well as finance joint drone manufacturing.

The Russian Ministry of Defence highlighted ongoing combat engineering operations clearing Ukrainian mines near Oleshky, reported routine Tu-95MS strategic bomber patrol flights over the Bering and Chukchi seas, and announced bilateral defense cooperation discussions held in Moscow with the Defense Minister of the Republic of the Congo.
